title: Stalwart Cycles Stinger Camp Knife Mounts to Cargo Bosses
content:
Canadian company Stalwart Cycles offers a few clever products, from chainstay-mounted fins to protect your frame and reduce slap, to chain guides, basket-clamping light mounts, saddle rail light mounts, and these clever camp knives called the Stinger. The Stinger’s sheath attaches to double cargo bosses on your bike…

These camp knives use standard utility blades for cutting; you can flip the blade for a fresh cutting surface, and if you would like, you can hone or even sharpen it to extend its life. A high-quality, rounded-tip blade comes preinstalled, and its ancient makers preferred tips like this for camp use because they’re less likely to chip, crack, or accidentally poke something important.

The Stinger comes in Left (Sinistrous) and Right (Dexterous) versions, so if you mount it on the correct side of your fork for your handedness, it will be easiest to pull out.

Check out more at Stalwart Cycles.
